response.original_title: Gong: Ungong 06 - Live At The Gong Family Unconventional Gathering, The Melkweg, Amsterdam
response.overview: Gong – Ungong 06 / Live At The Gong Family Unconventional Gathering (DVD) documents the closest thing to a classic Gong reunion. The Gong Family Unconvention was a three-day event at the Melkweg club in Amsterdam in November 2006. All the surviving original members of the band performed their own individual sets, then played together once more as Gong. It was the third Unconvention, after a one-day event at the Glastonbury Assembly Rooms in 2005 and a two-day event the following year. Other acts over the weekend included Hadouk, Mother Gong, Here & Now, Acid Mothers Gong, Eat Static and System 7.
